actions.loadLatest: Discard my edits and load the latest

activation.new-session-required: Applies to new sessions; a running external agent keeps the instructions it started with.
activation.next-operation: Applies to the next call that uses it; nothing needs restarting.

conflict.body: The file changed on disk after it was opened. Your text is kept below the changes made on disk; choose which one to keep.
conflict.diffLabel: Differences between the file on disk and your text
conflict.takeDisk: Discard my text and load the file
conflict.title: The file changed on disk

detail.missing: This prompt is no longer available.

facts.requiredFragments: Text the reply parser depends on

fallback.contract-incompatible: the override was written for an older contract
fallback.snapshot-unavailable: the overrides could not be read

history.compareHint: Changes from this revision to the text in the editor.
history.diffLabel: Changes from the revision to the editor
history.empty: Nothing has been saved at this scope yet.
history.title: Revisions

inspectOnly.body: A parser or a host contract reads this text, so it is shown for reference and cannot be overridden.
inspectOnly.title: Read-only protocol text

issues.missingFragment: Must keep "{fragment}": the reply parser depends on it.
issues.pii: The text looks like it contains personal data, which prompts must not carry.
issues.unknownVariable: {name} is not a variable of this prompt.

lastUsed.never: Not used since this window opened

omission.bare-mode: skipped: bare mode does not read instruction files
omission.load-failed: the files could not be read; a turn would continue without them
omission.no-filesystem: this host has no project files to read

customHint.character: Saving creates a variant of this agent that owns only its prompt and follows the agent for everything else.
customHint.custom-mode: Saving creates your own copy of this mode.
customHint.preset: Saving creates your own copy of this preset; choose "Use by default" on the copy to make it the default.
customHint.skill: Saving creates your own copy of this Skill with its resources.
customHint.subagent-template: Saving creates your own subagent from this template, with its settings.
customHint.team-template: Saving creates your own copy of the whole template, with only this teammate's prompt changed.

ownerOnly.composer-template: A chat template is inserted as your own message, not as a system instruction. Edit it in Chat templates, which keeps its parameters and revisions consistent.

ownerActivation.app-setting: Used by chats whose agent and session set no prompt of their own, from their next turn.
ownerActivation.character: Used from the next turn of every chat with this agent.
ownerActivation.composer-template: Inserted into the composer when you choose it.
ownerActivation.custom-mode: Used from the next turn of chats in this mode.
ownerActivation.instruction-file: Read from disk; used from the next turn in this workspace.
ownerActivation.preset: Applied when the preset is next applied to a chat; chats already using it keep their configuration.
ownerActivation.skill: Delivered by the Skill runtime the next time the Skill loads.
ownerActivation.workspace-instructions: Used from the next turn of chats in this workspace.
ownerActivation.subagent-template: Used the next time this subagent is delegated to.
ownerActivation.team-template: Copied into teams created from this template from now on; existing teams keep their own copy.

preview.description: The system prompt a new chat starts from, in the order a turn joins it. Sections only a turn can build are listed below it.
preview.railHint: What a new chat starts from
preview.sendTimeBody: Added by each turn from live state (recall, goals, plans, tools), so they are not previewed here.
preview.size: {chars, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} · ~{tokens} tokens
preview.skillsNote: The Skill runtime delivers these within its own budget; which ones load depends on the turn.
preview.title: Effective chat prompt
preview.total: {chars, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} · about {tokens} tokens before send-time sections

profile.applied: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing was published.} one {Published # override.} other {Published # overrides.}}
profile.appliedWithConflicts: Published {applied}; {conflicted} changed since the preview and were left alone.
profile.description: Move published overrides between machines and installations as one JSON file.
profile.exportHint: Every published override in the chosen scopes. Drafts and history stay here.
profile.invalidFile: This is not a prompt profile: {reason}
profile.mapHint: These overrides belong to workspaces, agents or chats of the machine they came from. Choose where each applies here, or skip it.
profile.nothingToExport: Nothing is published in the chosen scopes.
profile.title: Prompt profiles

rail.count: {total, plural, one {# prompt} other {# prompts}} · {modified} modified

resetDialog.bodyAccount: The account override is removed and the shipped text below applies again. History is kept and can be restored.
resetDialog.bodyScoped: This override is removed. Without it the slot falls back to the text below (an account override, or the shipped text); a conversation may still meet a narrower workspace or agent override. History is kept.
resetDialog.title: Reset this override?

riskNote.approval-sensitive: Takes part in an approval decision; a customized version can only make the outcome more conservative.
riskNote.ordinary: Wording only; a weak edit lowers output quality.
riskNote.protocol: Its reply is parsed; the required text must stay.

status.inherits: Not overridden at this scope; it inherits.

toast.conflict: This prompt changed elsewhere. Your text is kept; load the latest to continue.
toast.draftSaved: Draft saved. It is not used until you publish it.
toast.followsBase: Now follows the base prompt again.
toast.published: Published. The next call uses it.
toast.reset: Reset. The inherited text applies again.
toast.scope: This prompt cannot be overridden at that scope.

unavailable.title: Not available right now
unavailable.plugin: This prompt belongs to the plugin {plugin}, which is not enabled. Your text is kept and included in exports, and applies again when the plugin is enabled with a compatible version.
unavailable.retired: This version of Cognia no longer uses this prompt. Your text is kept and included in exports.
unavailable.noActive: No published text, only a draft or a reset.
unavailable.confirmBody: Its published text, draft and history at this scope are deleted for good. Export a profile first to keep a copy.

warnings.contractBody: The prompt's inputs or output contract changed in this version. The override is kept but not used; edit it against the new contract and publish again.
warnings.staleBody: Someone published or reset this slot while you were editing. Your text is kept.
warnings.upstreamBody: Cognia updated the shipped text after this override was written. Compare with the shipped text to see what changed.
